s004: 하상기 (the "Operator") handles users' personal information with care while providing ShareRun (the "App"), and complies with the Personal Information Protection Act and other applicable laws. The Operator processes only the minimum personal information needed to provide the service. This policy explains what information the Operator collects and why, how it is used and kept, and what rights you have.
s010: The identifier and email address provided by the sign-in service (Google, Kakao, Naver), the nickname set in the app, and the male/female avatar choice (a photo picked from your gallery is stored only on your phone and is not sent to the server)
s011: Sign-up and sign-in, account linking, showing your nickname. The email address is used only to find and link an existing account registered with the same email; the link record keeps only a hash value, not the email itself.
s013: Distance, time, average speed, route (location), gyro (movement) stability score, device model, operating system and app version used, and whether a watch or heart rate was used
s014: Verifying fraudulent records, granting rewards (such as SHARE), tournament rankings, and checking problems. Location is received at the level you allow, precise or approximate. When you pick up a diamond box on the map, your current location is sent to the server to check that you are near the box; this location is discarded right after the check and is not stored.
s016: Step counts read from the device step sensor and Health Connect
s017: Showing daily steps, pedometer rewards, and checking that the steps were walked by you
s019: Heart rate read from Health Connect, and cadence (stepping speed) during a run
s020: Showing heart rate while running and checking that the run was yours. It is read only with your separate consent. The raw values are used only for verification calculations and are not stored on the server; only whether heart rate was used (yes/no) is kept.
s022: List of signed-in devices (device model, operating system, app version, last access time), Google Play Integrity check result, and a device identifier created by the app (to tell signed-in devices apart and to limit trial rewards to once)
s023: Account protection, signing out of multiple devices, and preventing misuse. IP addresses and location are not stored in this list.
s025: Google Play order number and purchase confirmation value (the purchase token is kept as a hash), DIA, SHARE and VALUE balances and change history, and the content of refund requests
s026: Payment confirmation, granting currency, refund handling, and responding to disputes
s028: Crew name, membership status and role, nickname (visible to members of the same crew), and sponsorship records
s029: Crew features and showing sponsorship status. Only the sponsor can see their own sponsorship amount.
s031: The explanation and evidence photo you submit
s032: Deciding whether a record is recognized. The evidence is deleted as soon as a decision is made, and automatically after 14 days if there is no decision.
s034: The content you report and the target (nickname, crew, etc.)
s035: Handling inappropriate content and preventing misuse
s038: Granting referral rewards and preventing misuse
s040: The device value used to send push notifications (FCM token) and notification settings
s041: Notifications about tournaments, verification results and rewards
s043: Whether you consent to use for AI training, and the change history
s044: Used only if you consent. The default is no consent.
s045:
· Location is used only while recording a run and when picking up a diamond box. A saved route omits the 300 m near the start and end so your home location is not revealed.
· The microphone is used only when you tap "Speak" in the snail bot, and the camera only when you take a background photo for the finish card. The app does not send or store your voice or finish card photos on the server. However, speech recognition may be processed by the speech recognition service installed on your phone (for example, Google).
· Advertising identifiers that you have not set yourself are not collected.
s047: The app reads only step counts and heart rate from Health Connect and does not write. The data read is used only for the purposes in the table above; it is not used for advertising, sale, or credit or insurance decisions, and is not handed to third parties. The Operator does not view this data in person, except where needed for security, such as investigating misuse.

s050: Account information and activity records: until you delete the account. When you delete, it is handled as described under "Account deletion" below.
s051: Appeal evidence photos: immediately upon decision, or 14 days if there is no decision.
s052: Payment and currency transaction records (records on contracts or withdrawal of subscription): kept for 5 years under Article 6(1)2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce.
s053: Destruction procedure and method. Personal information is destroyed without delay once its retention period ends or its processing purpose is achieved. When you delete your account, the sign-in account and push notification value are deleted immediately, the currency balance is set to 0, and the account status is changed to "deleted". Activity records such as running records are deleted from the database by a cleanup job that handles deleted accounts together. It is completed within 30 days after account deletion. Payment and transaction records that must be preserved by law are kept separately from other information (the legal basis and period are stated under "2. Retention period" above) and are deleted when the retention period ends. Electronic files are destroyed by deleting them from the database.
s055: The Operator does not provide personal information to outside parties without your consent. To operate the service, it uses the services of the companies below.
s058: Google LLC (Firebase authentication, database and cloud server, Google Play billing, Play Integrity, Google Maps)
s059: Sign-in, data storage, server operation, payment confirmation, device checks, map display
s061: Identity verification when you sign in with that service
s062: The database that stores app data (Firestore) and the server (Cloud Run) are in the Republic of Korea (Seoul) region. However, the services below may be processed on overseas servers operated by Google, so your information may be transferred abroad. The type of transfer is processing entrustment and storage to provide the service, and the legal basis is Article 28-8(1)3 of the Personal Information Protection Act (overseas processing entrustment and storage for performance of a contract).
s069: Google LLC (Firebase authentication, push notifications, Google Play billing and integrity checks, Google Maps)
s070: The United States and the countries where Google has data centers (see the data center locations published by Google)
s071: Sign-in account information, device value for push notifications, payment confirmation information, device integrity check results, location for map display
s072: Sent over the network when signing in, using the app and paying
s073: Sign-in, sending notifications, payment confirmation, device checks, map display. The retention period follows Google's policy.
s074: If you do not want your information transferred abroad, you can stop using the service and delete your account. Kakao and Naver are Korean companies.
s075: How to refuse the transfer and its effect. You can request that the overseas transfer be stopped through "Delete account" in the app or the contact below. However, the services above are needed for sign-in, notifications, payments and maps, so if you refuse the transfer you cannot use these features and it becomes difficult to use the app.
s077: You can at any time view, correct or delete your personal information, or request that its processing be stopped. You can change consent items on the app's "My" screen and delete your account through "My → Settings → Delete account". If you cannot use the app, make your request at the contact below. Requests are handled within 10 days.
s078: For the detailed deletion procedure, see the account deletion guide. For the conditions of using the service, see the Terms of Service.
s080: Children under 14 years of age cannot sign up. At sign-up you are asked to confirm that you are 14 or older, and the time of confirmation is recorded (your date of birth is not collected).
s082: Without human involvement, the Operator uses an automated verification system (a rule-based system that decides by set criteria and does not learn from your information) to decide whether a running record is recognized and whether a reward (such as VALUE) is granted accordingly (Article 37-2 of the Personal Information Protection Act).
s083: Subjects and purpose: users who submit running records. This is to filter out records made on scooters, bicycles or vehicles, or records that cannot be regarded as walking or running, and to give rewards only for records you ran yourself.
s084: Information used and how decisions are made: distance, time, average speed, speed by route segment, step count and stride, movement (gyro) stability, device integrity check results, and (if you consent) heart rate and cadence. A record that meets the criteria is recognized; one that appears to be made on a means of transport, or whose values do not match each other, is not recognized and no reward is granted. The detailed criteria are not disclosed in order to prevent misuse.
s085: Sensitive information: heart rate is used only if you separately consent. Information of children under 14 is not processed.
s086: Refusal and requesting an explanation: if you believe a record was wrongly rejected, you can submit an explanation and an evidence photo on the app's appeal (objection) screen, or ask by the email below for an explanation of the reason for the decision and a review. The Operator reviews appeals in person again and tells you the result.
s087: 7. How personal information is kept safe
s089: Currency, reward and sponsorship amounts are changed only on the server; the app does not write the values directly.
s090: Staff who can access personal information are limited, and administrator access (such as appeal evidence) is logged.
s091: We do not promise perfect security, but we make efforts to protect personal information through the measures above.
s094: If you need help with a personal information breach, you can seek advice or file a report with: the Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee (1833-6972, dial without an area code; www.kopico.go.kr), the Personal Information Infringement Report Center (118, dial without an area code; privacy.kisa.or.kr), and the National Police Agency (182, dial without an area code; ecrm.police.go.kr)
s097: When the content changes, it is announced 7 days before it takes effect, for example by an in-app notice. Changes that greatly affect your rights, such as the items collected or the purposes of processing, are separately explained by comparing before and after, and changes unfavorable to you are announced 30 days before.
